lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: HEY NIX, [beat] PREPARE TO GET EXPELLED FOR CRASHING MY SCOOTER INTO THE LAKE LAST NIGHT, YOU LOSER!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That is funny, Bruno, [beat] because I was actually busy helping the elderly neighbor you almost ran over while you were joyriding.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Nix is telling the truth, and [beat] Mrs. Higgins was so grateful that she brought in the security footage from her porch to thank him.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait, security footage? [beat] That doesn't prove anything about my ride! You are just trying to deflect the blame onto me!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Actually, it shows you [beat] taking a hammer to the frame because you wanted your parents to buy you the new pro-model for your birthday.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I am so disappointed in you, Bruno; [beat] I really thought you were a better kid than someone who would frame my son for your own greed.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The best part is, [beat] I already told the repair shop to fix your old scooter using the spare parts I earned from helping the neighborhood.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You... you fixed it? [beat] Even after I told everyone at school you were a thief and a coward? Why would you even do that?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Because keeping a grudge [beat] is a lot more expensive than just being a decent human being for once in your life, you total idiot.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Bruno, you will be serving detention [beat] for the next month, while Nix receives the Community Hero award at the next assembly.

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: I guess being nice actually pays off [beat] much better than having a rich uncle or a fancy new scooter, does it not, big brother?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
